summary: Cửa ngõ AI doanh nghiệp nhanh nhất, cung cấp routing mô hình, cân bằng tải thích nghi và guardrails cho hơn 1000 mô hình LLM.
usecases: Route and load-balance requests to hundreds of LLM providers in enterprise AI platforms
Centralize AI model access with guardrails and cost monitoring for internal tools
Enable fast, low-latency AI agent orchestration with adaptive clustering
ideas: Build a unified API layer for multiple LLM providers with automatic failover
Integrate with internal knowledge bases for RAG pipelines with guardrails
Create a self-hosted alternative to OpenAI gateway with cost tracking and routing
